# IT Remote Access Requirements

Policy ID: IT-SEC-007.

## Connecting Remotely

All remote connections must use the corporate VPN and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
Public Wi-Fi may only be used together with the VPN.

## Remote Work Frequency

For security staffing reasons, IT department employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week.

## Lost or Stolen Devices

Report lost or stolen devices to the Service Desk within 24 hours at https://servicedesk.example.com/report.
